fusions.name: Split Bough
fusions.desc: Hurls a split bough that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets. It then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3.5 tiles, the hit dealing 100% of the original damage. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Crossed Purposes
fusions.desc: Seizes up to 2 enemies within 3.5 tiles, deals 10 damage to each and stuns them for 1 second, then turns them against each other for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Two-Pronged Guard
fusions.desc: Returns 50% of the damage you take to whoever dealt it for 9 seconds, and each such blow has a 30% chance to turn the attacker against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Either Hand
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
